This page shows how each architectural component of ALIGATEHR-Gen contributes to overall performance. Each bar represents the change in performance when a specific module is removed from the full model.

## Performance Impact of Removing Model Components

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

import { bindHighlightGroups } from "./chart-highlighting.js"
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

ablationData = {
  const text = await FileAttachment("data/ablation_results.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text, d3.autoType);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

ablationDiseases = [...new Set(ablationData.map(d => d.disease))]
ablationMetrics = [...new Set(ablationData.map(d => d.metric))]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof ablationDisease = Inputs.select(ablationDiseases, { label: "Disease", value: ablationDiseases[0] })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof ablationMetric = Inputs.select(ablationMetrics, { label: "Metric", value: "AUROC" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

ablationChart = {
  const filtered = ablationData.filter(d => d.disease === ablationDisease && d.metric === ablationMetric);
  filtered.sort((a, b) => a.delta - b.delta);

  const barMarks = filtered.map((row, index) =>
    Plot.barX([row], {
      className: `chart-highlight-series ablation-series-${index}`,
      x: "delta",
      y: "variant",
      fill: "delta",
      tip: true,
      title: d => `${d.variant}\n${d.disease} · ${d.metric}\nFull model: ${d.full_model_value.toFixed(4)}\nVariant: ${d.value.toFixed(4)}\nΔ: ${d.delta >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${d.delta.toFixed(4)}`,
    })
  );
  const labelMarks = filtered.map((row, index) =>
    Plot.text([row], {
      className: `chart-highlight-series ablation-series-${index}`,
      x: "delta",
      y: "variant",
      text: d => `${d.delta >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${d.delta.toFixed(4)}`,
      dx: row.delta < 0 ? -10 : 0,
      dy: -12,
      textAnchor: row.delta < 0 ? "end" : "start",
      fontSize: 11,
      fill: "#2c3e50",
    })
  );

  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: 1000,
    height: 350,
    marginLeft: 220,
    marginRight: 80,
    x: {
      label: `Δ ${ablationMetric} (relative to full model)`,
      grid: true,
    },
    y: {
      label: null,
      domain: filtered.map(d => d.variant),
    },
    color: {
      type: "diverging",
      scheme: "RdBu",
      domain: [-0.06, 0.06],
      reverse: true,
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleX([0], { stroke: "#2c3e50", strokeWidth: 1.5, strokeDasharray: "4,3" }),
      ...barMarks,
      ...labelMarks,
    ],
  });

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  const titleDiv = document.createElement("div");
  const fullVal = filtered[0]?.full_model_value?.toFixed(4) || "N/A";
  titleDiv.innerHTML = `<strong style="font-size:1.1rem;color:#2c3e50;">Performance Impact of Removing Model Components</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#6c757d;">${ablationDisease} · ${ablationMetric} · Full model baseline: ${fullVal}</span>`;
  titleDiv.style.marginBottom = "8px";
  container.appendChild(titleDiv);
  container.appendChild(chart);

  const hint = document.createElement("div");
  hint.className = "chart-highlight-hint";
  hint.textContent = "Hover or select a component to highlight it; select it again or press Esc to clear.";
  container.appendChild(hint);

  const variants = filtered.map(d => d.variant);
  const seriesNodes = new Map(variants.map((variant, index) => [
    variant,
    [...chart.querySelectorAll(`.ablation-series-${index}`)],
  ]));
  bindHighlightGroups({
    groupKeys: variants,
    targetsByGroup: seriesNodes,
    labelForGroup: variant => `Highlight ${variant}`,
  });

  return container;
}
```
